title: Trove medical observation
description: One line of health/medical/<source>/observations/YYYY-MM.jsonl: a lab result or vital sign (FHIR Observation / DiagnosticReport, or a parsed lab PDF). Additive evolution: readers tolerate unknown fields.

ts.description: RFC3339 local effective/collection time, or a date-only YYYY-MM-DD when that is all the source gives (clinical data is routinely date-granular)

source.description: collector id; identical to the source folder name (lowercase/digits/dash)

guid.description: source-unique id, the dedupe key: FHIR Observation.id (org-scoped), or hash+test+date for a parsed PDF

code.description: terminology code (FHIR coding.code) — LOINC for labs/vitals; omitted by a PDF-parsed row

code_system.description: which system the code is from: "loinc" | "snomed" | …

value.description: numeric result (FHIR valueQuantity.value), paired with unit

value_text.description: qualitative result (FHIR valueString: "Positive", "Non-Reactive", …) for non-numeric tests

unit.description: unit of value, UCUM where FHIR-sourced ("mg/dL", "mm[Hg]")

provider.description: ordering provider or lab, as a display name

extra.description: everything source-specific (specimen, status, full resource, confidence)
